name: 뿔카노
light: In a basalt quarry maintenance hall at dawn, steady front three-quarter standing pose, both empty hands open beside her hips. Angular charcoal and silver rocky armor edges; a small single conical horn-shaped crest on a slim forehead band. Human skin. Entire head and feet visible.
casual: In an empty mineral auction salon at evening, presenting a small polished geode on a velvet tray at waist height, both hands supporting opposite sides. Warm spotlights and stone plinths.

Original auction-host event costume: opaque graphite strapless fitted bodice, silver asymmetric short tailored skirt, slim ankle boots, tiny crystal earrings; bare shoulders arms and legs. No workplace insignia.

In an indoor bouldering gym at late afternoon, standing side-on while lightly dusting chalk from two separated open palms before a climb. Both feet on the padded floor, colorful climbing holds behind her, empty gym.
Opaque slate racerback sports bra with secure broad straps, high-waisted charcoal athletic shorts, climbing shoes. Bare arms shoulders midriff and legs; tiny horn-shaped zipper pull.

In a ceramic glazing atelier on a rainy morning, seated twisting gently toward a table, applying a glaze brush to a small ceramic bowl with one hand, other hand steadying its outer rim. Both hands fully visible and apart, cool skylight.
Opaque ivory sleeveless cropped work blouse with a square neckline, high-waisted slate linen trousers below crop, narrow apron tied at waist; bare arms shoulders and small midriff.
